subject: Request: Dedicated capacity demo / throughput & latency requirements
messages:
From: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request — Dedicated capacity (throughput/latency)

Hi Marissa,

We signed up and are evaluating Redwood Dedicated for a latency-sensitive deduplication pipeline. High level:
- Peak traffic ~2,000 requests/minute (p95 spikes to 3,500)
- Typical request size ~256 tokens; worst-case 1,024 tokens
- Target p99 latency < 300ms for 256-token responses; p95 < 150ms
- We need throughput guarantees and predictable unit costs.

Can we schedule a demo and a technical deep dive next week to review capacity sizing and latency SLOs? I've attached a short requirements doc. Also looping in procurement for contracting questions.

Thanks,
Sara Thompson
Senior Platform Engineer, Acme Inc.
Attachments: acme_initial_requirements.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-05-20T16:10:00-07:00
